page.summary: This is the preserved historical luck/Kobe self-unhook identity. It is not a current ranked strategy or a current four-perk build; use C12 — Deterministic Self-Unhook for the source-supported replacement family.
whatItWas: Older guides and community terminology used the luck/Kobe identity for attempting to escape from a hook through probability, historically naming Slippery Meat with luck effects as the defining package.
Its value was the recognizable historical self-unhook plan, not a current evaluation that can be compared with today's Solo Q or Coordinated SWF rankings.
whyNotCurrent: The canonical snapshot marks C13 LEGACY with NOT_CURRENT environments. The 10.2.0 Slippery Meat record removed the former self-unhook attempt/chance bonuses and now describes faster teammate unhooks plus post-unhook Haste.

Do not treat the old name, current Slippery Meat page or a historical luck label as proof that the former engine still functions. Do not convert the historical identity into a current D-tier build or invent a current loadout.

successors.why: Deterministic Self-Unhook is the exact source-supported successor family: it banks self-rescue through a prior safe altruistic action rather than relying on the invalidated luck interaction.

historicalPerks.historicalUse: Historically named as the defining self-unhook/luck perk in the old package. Its current live mechanics no longer improve self-unhook attempts, so this historical reference is not a current recommendation.
